verdict.rationale: Morph is API-first: one API key covers the chat models and every specialized tool (Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact, Reflexes), and even custom Reflex training runs through API jobs. However, no evidence claims full UI-to-API parity. Dedicated-endpoint provisioning reads as a plan-selection flow with no documented API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (all probe paths returned 404). missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, documented API for account/key/billing and dedicated-endpoint provisioning, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools: Fast Apply for edits, WarpGrep for search, Compact for compression, Reflexes for classification.
Send labeled examples, get back a text classifier. Create a job, poll until it finishes, then classify text against it.
Eleven ship ready to use; pass the name as `model`.
